title: What happened in AI — Oct 24, 2026
intro: Agent infrastructure moved from SDKs to managed platform: Google launched Agent Compute Engine with expanded agent governance at AGNTCon + MCPCon, and made Data Agent Kit generally available with guardrails split between skills and IAM.

Builder guidance pointed the other way on complexity: Anthropic advises folding subagents back into one agent loop, and a field report shows an agent can ignore a tool it was given. Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro (3T parameters, open weights) dominated model coverage.
highlights: Google launches Agent Compute Engine and expanded agent governance for concurrent agent sessions.
Data Agent Kit hits GA: MCP tools plus 37 open-source skills across 15+ Google Data Cloud services.
Anthropic: fewer subagents and progressively disclosed context can improve quality and cut cost and latency.
An agent given an MCP tool may still not call it; same instruction, different project, different behavior.
Moonshot ships Kimi K3.1 Pro: 3T parameters, 1M context, open weights.
